📊 £431.3 BILLION.

That's what the OBR expects welfare to cost by 2031/32 - up £116.5bn (37%) from the final full Tory year. And the big welfare decisions? Pushed to 2027.

Debt interest is also £14bn higher than expected this year. Working families are footing the bill.
